compounding_legal.label: Compounding-legal
compounding_legal.meaning: A licensed pharmacy may compound it on prescription: it is on the FDA 503A bulk-substances list or is an ingredient of an FDA-approved drug that is not on the market. This is not the same as being an FDA-approved drug.

under_review.label: Under review
under_review.meaning: Actively before the FDA advisory committee; a decision is pending and the status can move.

in_limbo.label: In limbo
in_limbo.meaning: Moved on paper - nominated, removed from a restricted list, or recommended by an FDA committee - but not added to the 503A list. The headline implies a change; the legal status has not moved.

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.meaning: Prescription-only, banned, controlled, or under active FDA enforcement.

unscheduled.label: Unscheduled
unscheduled.meaning: No specific federal action; unaddressed at this time.
